review_process: Separate read-only source, representation and nested visual/adversarial roles use gpt-5.6-sol/ultra. Parent alone edits and owns Git/lock. Model review is not independent human or laboratory evidence.

adjudications.objection: The50mL/2mM/130micromol tuple is inconsistent; isolated-yield arithmetic could silently select one quantity.
adjudications.decision: Retain all quantities, the100micromol dimensional check, and printed60.1%yield; block amount-normalized or repaired-yield inference.

adjudications.objection: Methods andS12 reverse R/S retention assignments; discarding the sourceR label would also discard its separately stated optical-rotation basis.
adjudications.decision: Keep both retention maps and null normalized mapping. Retain source-assigned R-major with reported rotation/literature basis; no independent standard/reference validation.

adjudications.objection: Draft copied8F configuration and rotation evidence onto precursor control arms.
adjudications.evidence: SIp11 andS12p29; separate and independently raised source/representation/visual objections.
adjudications.decision: Make shared reaction and conversion product neutral. Keep8F assignment only on its composition row; altered precursor gets caption-only assignment;0.7%arm has no configuration.

adjudications.objection: Strict source ee bound could become exact arithmetic, or precursor44%ee could become matched3h selectivity.
adjudications.decision: Retain>98.4%and exact displayed-ratio arithmetic separately. Keep44%on1day/approximately50fold-enzyme arm; no exact altered yield or full assay reconstructed.

adjudications.objection: Theoretical71%yield might be treated as measured isolation or a universal equilibrium ceiling.
adjudications.decision: Keep source calculation beside separate apparent-equilibrium assay; note measured0.1-1.0Macetone versus nominal2Msynthesis without refitting or extrapolation validation.

adjudications.objection: Old common relation had no first-class reaction participants, and repeated whole reaction objects invite scope drift.
adjudications.decision: Add a generic source-bound reaction/participant primitive; one canonical reaction provider, assay reaction IDs, named sides/roles. All case chemistry stays in data; old missing contexts remain null.

adjudications.objection: A generic comparison block could erase the source-declared precursor control.
adjudications.decision: Scope the block to generic perturbation arithmetic; preserve the exact declared descriptive precursor relation and distinct preparation IDs as structured context.

blocked_operations: independently verified absolute configuration or unambiguous retention label
same-condition precursor ee transfer from altered conditions
single-group synthetic effect from cleavage mutations
rate pooling or cleavage-to-synthesis selectivity transfer
productive geometry, full mechanism, design-success rate or evidence-tier promotion

reviews.scope: RetainedSI Methodspp9-11,17 andFigureS12p29; quantities, stereochemical assignments, controls and source conflicts.
Independent-in-team visual source reading and adversarial checks of product/control/direction and equilibrium transfer limits; no independent human review.
Canonical participant sides/roles, exact reactant ID set, source-assay direction, isolated product assignments and source-bound context checks.

completion_note: All three separately prompted or nested read-only roles accepted their exact current scientific scope after source objections were corrected. Parent finalizes only review metadata after those acceptances; required tests and exact-head CI remain publication gates.
